deep.reconstruction:
No mathematics on this page: no formulas, computations or derivations. It is a methodological prose passage from Riemann's drafts for the posthumously published essay 'Über die Mechanik des Ohres' (ed. Henle, Zeitschrift für rationelle Medicin, 1867). The previous page discusses the middle-ear (Paukenhöhle) ossicle apparatus as a rigid body turning about an axis. The next page discusses timbre (Klangfarbe) and estimating the distance of a sound source.

Content, in order:
(1) A deleted opening: 'Die Bezeichnungen analytisch und synthetisch für diese beiden Forschungsweisen…'
(2) The retained version: for the two opposed modes of research, the labels 'synthetic' and 'analytic' apply only approximately. Strictly speaking, neither a purely synthetic nor a purely analytic investigation is possible.
(3) An added paragraph criticising the synthetic method, which reasons from anatomical structure to function. One is forced to fill gaps by appeal to analogy or teleology, which leaves much room for arbitrariness. Every step therefore becomes uncertain, and the uncertainty grows the further one proceeds, until one must give up continuing. The synthetic procedure thus mostly yields only isolated, and for that reason unconfirmed (probably 'durch nichts bestätigten'), conjectures.

This is the epistemological framing of the essay. Riemann prefers the 'analytic' route: start from the known performance of the ear, namely its fine perception of timbre, and infer the mechanical conditions the apparatus must satisfy. The passage corresponds closely to text in the published essay. The page is mostly a heavily corrected draft of it.

results.what: Methodological distinction between synthetic (structure-to-function) and analytic (function-to-mechanism) research in physiology; neither is possible in pure form, and the synthetic method yields only uncertain conjectures relying on analogy or teleology
results.modern_name: Inverse-problem / functional-requirement approach to sensory physiology (methodology of biomechanics)
results.usually_credited_to: Bernhard Riemann, 'Über die Mechanik des Ohres' (posthumous, 1867)

deep.surprise_reason: Non-mathematical draft of a well-known methodological passage from Riemann's published posthumous essay on the mechanics of the ear. Nothing new.
transcription_corrections: Folio number '38' appears at top right of the page.
'den weiteren Nachfolgen aufzugeben' is doubtful. The sense requires something like 'die weiteren Nachforschungen aufzugeben' or 'den weiteren Verfolg aufzugeben'; the image is ambiguous.

'eben deshalb durch nicht bestätigten Vermuthungen' should most likely read 'durch nichts bestätigten Vermuthungen'. The final line 'nichts bestätigten Vermuthungen' stands at the left margin under the insertion 'vereinzelten'.
'nur ap-/proximativ' is correct, split across the line break after the deleted 'genau genommen'.
The insertion above 'weder' at the end of the line looks like 'eigentlich' or 'strenge'; the marginal addition at the right edge is uncertain.
In 'Man ist daher zu einer Ergänzung…' the word 'bleibt' after 'Spielraum' replaces a struck word, and 'und es' is partly struck and rewritten.
